steps: Verify current CPU requests/limits and confirm no memory or network bottlenecks.
[GATE] On-call engineer approves a temporary increase to the recommendationservice CPU limits to match observed peak usage.

Monitor latency and CPU metrics for 15 minutes and revert the deployment if stabilization is not achieved.
